mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during tightening cycles, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising unemployment, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth by more than 1% over two quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of GDP decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production by more than 2% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of industrial production increase, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over two months signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of housing starts increase, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate coupled with a rise in consumer price index signals inflationary pressures, leading to a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate fiscal stimulus.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of decreasing FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of decreasing nonfarm payrolls, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real final sales of 2% over two quarters signals a strengthening demand environment, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of increasing real final sales, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
